question: Give reasons why integrated circuits are important in modern electronic devices.

options.A: Integrated circuits are important because they make electronic devices larger and require more power.
options.B: Integrated circuits contain many components on one chip, making devices compact, fast and low-power. Fewer external connections improve reliability, and mass production lowers cost.
options.C: Integrated circuits are important only because they increase the number of soldered joints and external connections.
options.D: Integrated circuits are slower and less reliable than discrete circuits because their components are closer.
